refinement.implementation: Local NVlabs/Sana alternative route described by supplied server documentation; not the full MiniMax H3 teacher model.

rawAlignmentTailPolicy: Keep original model output unchanged. Make exact five-second video-only inputs; final cuts are 2-5 seconds.
referencePolicy: Scene image guides composition and appearance; previously reviewed video supplies restrained motion. Current OpenAPI exposes task=ref2va only, without a separate first-frame-lock parameter. Prompt intention is not a guarantee of a strictly fixed first frame. No persona text is uploaded.
acceptancePolicy: All actual generated source frames and final inputs require independent semantic review. HTTP success and face detection are not approval.
preservation: Keep all requests, upload receipts, polls, original downloads, failed attempts, corrected versions and final films outside Git. Save every generated artwork and inspection image in this episode and commit it.
